notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check; evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level. Model-authored (driver.lock.json authored_by kind model) and unreviewed (reviewed_by null); no hardware was attached and no hardware run is claimed. The package has no hardware backend: mode simulated, risk R0 (the card floor). The upstream TaskSchedulingEnv has no gymnasium.register entry and its constructor needs a DatacenterClusterManager, a start and end time and a reward function (envs/task_scheduling_env.py:28-30), and the upstream needs pandas, numpy, torch and the Alibaba workload dataset; nothing was installed and the card's mock_strategy.preferred upstream-sim path was not run. The only backend is the package fake (fake.py), a pure-Python stand-in that models a fixed five-datacenter test configuration (single_action_mode and disable_defer_action, configs/env/sim_config.yaml:16-17) and a 34-element aggregated observation; its datacenter totals, prices, carbon intensities, start time, task sizes and reward/info values are placeholders, not facts or limits. NOT COVERED: the DatacenterClusterManager/SustainDC cluster, the workload trace, the reward engine and the energy/carbon/thermal models, plus the real observation values; the fake was never compared with the upstream environment. Expected Gymnasium-family warnings only: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the next reset) and four G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived integer inputs ticks, action.index and seed twice (PLAYBOOK.md section 8); there were no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. Only catalogue classes (cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1) are used, so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest line the check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
